definitions.meaning: A friend of old or former times

quotations.english: knows that his friends of old are committed to earth

source_text: iú-wine, es ; m. A friend of old or former times :-- Wát his iúwine eorþan forgiefene knows that his friends of old are committed to earth, Exon. 82 b; Th. 311, 15 ; Seef. 92.
